scope: PipeWire audio input stream feeding a CaptureTake, checked against an independent reference on a private graph
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image (PipeWire 1.6.9), docker --network none, owned private PipeWire server at quantum 256, no devices or session manager
verified_behaviors: fl-live-input connects to the explicit remote with FL/FR F32 ports and records only once linked
Every captured frame equals the next frame of an independently authored stereo reference (distinct left and right sequences), channels in place
No bad buffers, dropped blocks or stream errors; the take finishes to its final name
setSink(nullptr) returns only after the data thread left the previous sink, so the take is finished safely right after
limits: Private software graph only; no physical input device, latency or timestamp measurement (#45); not yet wired into the desktop (#43).
